item.title: TPXimpact lands £24m in public-sector contract wins
item.summary: TPXimpact has secured contract wins and uplifts totalling £24m across two UK public-sector clients. The digital services company said it had won a £19m contract uplift and a one-year extension to its delivery partnership with HM Land Registry, taking the contract out to May 2028.
